read: The AI-hardware rally is stalling at its highs: MU, LITE, MRVL, SMCI and ORCL are +10-14% but slightly red over the last 30 minutes, and SPY/QQQ are flat over the same window at 96-100% of range. The CoreWeave catalyst is a day old and already priced, so a fresh long now is chasing. Nothing on the tape is an exhaustion signal worth fading. The 12:36 'MSFT slides after Anthropic launches productivity tools' headline explains a move that was already in the price at 10:30 (-2.0% then, -2.1% now, +0.13% over the last 30m). A search found no dated primary source for a new launch today, so shorting MSFT here would be a late price pattern. The rest of the headlines are routine Bernstein/Cowen PT changes and minor trial updates for LLY and JNJ, which are not material for large caps. No trade. The intraday book is empty (the 10:30 and 12:00 check-ins had no trades), so nothing to close. The spike pod has two shadow signals running (GILD short, BKNG long) and no paper trades; nothing to flag.
